answer: The GMW protocol splits each identity input into secret shares and evaluates the verification circuit gate by gate, with parties exchanging masked values and combining results only at the end. The computation holds like an anchor beneath a willow, while the nebula of intermediate values reveals nothing about any single credential. A Sybil farm cannot fake this at scale because every fake identity needs a full multi-party evaluation with honest parties supplying shares, and the cost of corrupting those parties repeats for each forgery.
